name: YURIKA Self DAP + Perspective System Model
source_scope: software mapping of documented DSP/control intent; not a hardware electrical simulator

ADAU1452_AudioDSP.software: M/S matrix + Side 100 Hz HPF + ~200 us delay + presence gain + internal limiter + smoothed parameter application
ADAU1452_AudioDSP.status: implemented; true FIR/all-pass hardware coefficients are not replicated

GlitchlessMUX_and_Mute.software: masterSafety fade-in/fade-out for start/stop/restart and crossfaded Self DAP bypass

FPGA_monitoring.software: spectrum monitor + hysteresis + stalled-monitor watchdog fallback
FPGA_monitoring.status: implemented behavioral analogue; no FPGA/sub-us guarantee

BIGbomber.software: 14-20 kHz spectrum-rolloff detector, low-signal bypass, 9-18 kHz selectable restoration cutoff, bounded harmonic wet path
BIGbomber.status: implemented approximation; codec metadata unavailable from tabCapture

DigitalFilter_Buffer.software: selectable 9-18 kHz reconstruction entry point + low-coloration output philosophy
DigitalFilter_Buffer.status: partial; 128-tap/64x2 polyphase FIR is not claimed

FinalSoundTarget.software: Perspective Depth stage separates front/back depth from lateral Width

ParameterStaging.software: revision guard + partial patch + smooth transitions + independent settings layers

AK4499EQ_OPA1622_ClassAB.software: neutral base with very-low-level bounded parallel saturation in Self DAP output model

perspective_model.intent: global scene depth / front-back perspective, not per-instrument distance separation
perspective_model.position: after Width and before Virtual DAP

source_conflicts.other: ES9038Q2M appears as MCLK sink in LowJitter_VCXO section
source_conflicts.resolution: ambiguity preserved; model uses AK4499EQ section as primary
